# Lucy

## Overview

- **Age:** 11 years old in Volume 1, reaching 18 years old in Volume 4  <sub>[v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062), [v4 c1 P16](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0016)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c2 P61](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0061)</sub>
- **Origin:** Pear Hill, Brierley  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>
- **Role:** Student; later housekeeper and mother  <sub>[v1 c15 P27](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0027), [v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Izzy  <sub>[v1 c18 P25](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0025), [v4 c1 P10](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

She is an attractive girl with rosy cheeks, dark eyes, and shiny black hair. She considers herself somewhat plump and wishes to be slender, though her figure is full and curvy as she grows older. She has dimples in her cheeks and a cheerful smile inherited from her father.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v3 c33 P13](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0013), [v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002)_

## Personality

She is cheerful, open-hearted, and pragmatic, often bursting into laughter before speaking. Deeply loyal and affectionate, she forms a firm bond with her best friend, though she lacks the vivid imagination of others and prefers realistic, practical matters. While prone to emotional outbursts and fears, she remains steadfast, sensible, and devoted to her family.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P26](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0026), [v1 c12 P37](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0037), [v1 c15 P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 c17 P5](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0005), [v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002)_

## Traits

- Loyal and affectionate  <sub>[v1 c17 P5](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0005)</sub>
- Fear of crossing bridges  <sub>[v1 c2 P65](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0065)</sub>
- Pragmatic and practical  <sub>[v1 c15 P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 c17 P11](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0011)</sub>
- Self-conscious about her weight  <sub>[v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v3 c33 P13](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0013)</sub>

## Abilities

- Crocheting and needlework  <sub>[v1 c18 P49](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0049)</sub>
- Singing  <sub>[v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040)</sub>
- Rowing a dory  <sub>[v1 c28 P8](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0008)</sub>

## Goals

- To be a loyal, lifelong friend to Nell  <sub>[v1 c12 P28](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0028)</sub>
- To build a happy home with her husband Gideon  <sub>[v1 c29 P28](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0028), [v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002)</sub>

## History

In her youth, she met Nell Harcourt and the two swore a solemn oath of lifelong friendship over an imagined stream in her garden. She attended Sunday school and the Brierley school alongside Nell, partaking in childhood games, playhouses, and a story-writing club. When her mother mistakenly believed Nell had gotten her intoxicated with wine, she was forbidden from playing with Nell, but the girls maintained their friendship through secret notes and farewell meetings until the misunderstanding was resolved. Later, she stood by Nell through school competitions, theatrical performances, and personal trials. As she grew into womanhood, she became courted by Gideon Duckett, eventually marrying him when she reached eighteen. She established a home in Brierley and gave birth to two children, including a daughter named Nell Lucinda in honor of her best friend.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P25](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0025), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c15 P15](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0015), [v1 c16 P63](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0063), [v1 c17 P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c29 P10](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0010), [v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002), [v4 c1 P16](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0016), [v4 c4 P15](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0015)_

## Background by volume

- Raised at Pear Hill by her strict mother and amiable father  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c12 P14](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0014), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021)</sub>
- Named by a schoolmaster who lodged at her parents' house  <sub>[v1 c2 P64](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0064)</sub>

## Quotes

> The act of swearing is remarkably evil, after all.  <sub>[v1 c12 P30](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0030)</sub>

> You can be certain that my love for you, Nell, is devoted and will last forever.  <sub>[v1 c17 P9](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0009)</sub>

> Naturally, there are ups and downs in married life. Expecting all things to proceed smoothly all the time is a mistake. However, Nell, I can give you my assurance that life is happy, provided your husband is the right man.  <sub>[v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002)</sub>
